title: At my friend's house
instructions: Zoe arkadaşının evinde geçirdiği günü anlatıyor. Ne yaptıklarına dikkat et.

script.speaker: zoe
script.text: Today I am at my friend Lily's house.

script.speaker: zoe
script.text: Her house is big, and it has a swimming pool!

script.speaker: zoe
script.text: We swim in the pool and then we play with her cat.

script.speaker: zoe
script.text: Lily's mum makes us sandwiches for lunch.

script.speaker: zoe
script.text: My dad comes to get me at five o'clock.

questions.feedback: Saat beşte babası onu almaya geliyor.
questions.evidence: My dad comes to get me at five o'clock.
